descriptions.01: A clean, well-structured website with 1–3 pages. Responsive, fast, and search-engine ready. No bloat — just what your business needs to look credible online.
descriptions.02: A larger project with custom layout, considered animations, and content strategy. Includes competitor and market review to make sure your site works harder than theirs.
descriptions.03: For businesses that want something genuinely distinctive — 3D elements, advanced interactions, or a website that people remember. Tell us what you're after.
descriptions.04: A working online store with payment processing, inventory management, and analytics. We keep running costs low and focus on conversion — whether you're starting fresh or scaling up.
descriptions.04-1: Ongoing search engine optimisation: keyword research, technical improvements, and regular reporting so your site ranks where it should.
descriptions.04-2: We handle updates, security patches, performance monitoring, cache management, and content changes. Your site stays fast and secure without you thinking about it.
descriptions.05: A custom CRM built around your workflow. Manage contacts, track your pipeline, and keep your business relationships organised — without paying for features you'll never use.
descriptions.05-1: Automate the repetitive parts of your business. We build workflows that save time and reduce errors, connected to the tools you already use.
descriptions.05-2: Connect your existing platforms — booking systems, CRMs, payment tools, email — so data flows where it needs to without manual work.
descriptions.06: Targeted ad campaigns on Google and Meta. We set them up, monitor performance, and optimise for results — not vanity metrics.
descriptions.07: Consistent social media presence with clear strategy, quality content, and community management.

01.title: 01. Conversation
01.description: Get in touch and tell us what you're working on. We'll discuss your goals, audience, and expectations — honestly. If we're not the right fit, we'll tell you. A good project starts with a clear understanding of what you actually need.

02.title: 02. Research & Strategy
02.description: We study your business, your market, and your competitors. From there, we build a clear plan — site structure, user experience, positioning — so the end result performs, not just looks good.

03.title: 03. Design & Development
03.description: We design and build your site in parallel. Clean visuals, fast load times, SEO-friendly architecture, and attention to detail at every level. No templates. Everything is written and designed for your project.

04.title: 04. Review
04.description: You see the result, we walk through it together, and we refine. Feedback is part of the process — we adjust until you're satisfied with every detail.

05.title: 05. Launch
05.description: We handle the technical setup — domain, hosting, deployment — and test thoroughly across devices and browsers. When it goes live, it works.

06.title: 06. Ongoing Support
06.description: We stay available after launch. Maintenance, updates, and further development when your business evolves. Your site should grow with you.
